q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: WITH USER_LIST AS ( SELECT FOLLOWEE AS USER FROM FOLLOW UNION SELECT FOLLOWER AS USER FROM FOLLOW) ,CTE2 AS ( SELECT FOLLOWER AS USER FROM FOLLOW GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(FOLLOWEE) >= 1 ), CTE3 AS ( SELECT FOLLOWEE AS USER, COUNT(FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(FOLLOWER) >= 1 ) SELECT U.USER AS FOLLOWER ,CTE3.NUM FROM USER_LIST U JOIN CTE3 ON U.USER = CTE3.USER WHERE U.USER IN (SELECT USER FROM CTE2) ORDER BY 1 ASC
